Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere through examples.
Described cylinder as having two flat circular faces and one curved surface.
Matched dice, pencil box and matchbox with cube or cuboid.
Recognised a cylinder when its position changed; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes, matching them to everyday objects, and recognising them when turned or shown in different sizes. Ishita used shape features such as square faces, rectangular faces, circular faces, and curved surfaces; they correctly kept the shape as a cylinder after it was laid down. Ishita asked for clearer views of objects, so at home, show a few household items from different angles and ask which 3D shape each resembles.
